Context: The Main Echelon left Ford for Old Sarum on 4 June; Old Sarum is not treated as a home base, and no 6 June headquarters claim is entered (the squadrons remained at Ford until 15 June, and that date is not copied to the wing, J4). The same-day 14 June move through B.4 is noted and not stored as a separate staying station. The wing disbanded on 12 July 1944.
